title: Thimsy ES-DE/nano/emulators.json
description: The per-game emulator picks that ES-DE has no label for, from either platform (esdeStoreSaveGameEmu, NanoEsdeStore.cpp; OA-38: the last pick wins on both platforms, per game here and in the gamelists' <altemulator>). Written in place by both, so unknown top-level keys and other games' items survive, and the re-picked game's item is rebuilt as {game, label, am} or removed when its new pick has an ES-DE label. 'am' is the pick in Nano's emulator catalog on every platform (Daijishou's am start arguments), so each platform finds the same entry; a platform that cannot run it keeps the item and starts the game with its own default (LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 5). The 'key' field is this contract's addition (written from the compatibility floor on). Unknown fields are allowed here because the file is already in the field. Only the draft-07 keywords devicejson.py validates are used.

version.description: Android forces it to 1 on every write; never relied on.

game.description: ES-DE folder, '/', the path relative to it, case kept, no './'.

label.description: Nano's display label of the emulator.

am.description: The catalog entry's am start arguments (Nano's catalog is the same on both platforms); a reader loads an item only when it matches its catalog.

key.description: The portable key of the same choice that 'am' describes.
